entries.zh: 沿标记线看储能、滑动和回弹，再追踪传出去的振动。
entries.en: Follow the marker through loading, slip and rebound, then track the travelling disturbance.

entries.zh: 深入 · 受力与断层方向
深入 · 起点与正上方
接缝卡住，岩石为什么还能储能？
entries.en: How can rock store energy while the fault is locked?

entries.zh: 远处怎样受力，两侧就怎样相对滑动？
entries.en: How does loading relate to the relative slip direction?

entries.zh: 换一个地下起点，正上方会怎样改变？
entries.en: If the underground start changes, what happens directly above it?

entries.zh: 能量传到地表，岩石会被一路带走吗？
entries.en: Does travelling energy carry the rock all the way to the surface?

entries.zh: 先找棕色标记线和远端受力箭头；接缝还没有滑动。
entries.en: Find the brown marker and loading arrows. The fault has not slipped.

entries.zh: 接缝被摩擦锁住。远处仍受力，标记线弯了，岩石储存弹性能。
entries.en: Friction locks the fault. Loading continues farther away; the marker bends as rock stores elastic energy.

entries.zh: 突然滑动后，弯曲减少、储能下降，但标记线留下错位。
entries.en: After sudden slip, bending and stored energy decrease, but the marker stays offset.

entries.zh: 振动可以停下，错位却不会自动复原；回弹不等于两侧退回原位。
entries.en: Shaking can stop while the offset remains. Rebound does not undo the slip.

entries.zh: 看远端受力箭头，再比同一层岩石的相对错位；类型不是强弱排名。
entries.en: Compare the loading arrows with the offset of the same rock layer. Fault types do not rank earthquake strength.

entries.zh: 红点是破裂开始的位置。显示竖直投影，再换一个起点比较。
entries.en: The red point marks where rupture starts. Show its vertical projection, then compare another start.

entries.zh: 红点是震源；沿竖线到地表的圈是震中，不一定是摇得最强的地方。
entries.en: The red point is the focus. The surface ring directly above is the epicenter, not necessarily the strongest shaking.

entries.zh: 波前传递能量，地下和地表黄点只在各自原位附近往复。
entries.en: The front carries energy; underground and surface yellow points move around their own places.

entries.zh: 同一观测点先收到 P、再收到 S；局部振动结束后，黄点回到原处。
entries.en: At one observation point P arrives before S. After each pulse the yellow point returns to its place.

entries.zh: 放大形变、压缩时间的单次事件示意；不是地震倒计时，不能预测真实地震。
entries.en: One exaggerated event with compressed time; not a countdown or a real-earthquake prediction.

entries.zh: 独立的均匀介质波示意；不模拟分层折射、表面波或真实地震强弱。
entries.en: An independent uniform-medium wave illustration, without layered refraction, surface waves or real shaking intensity.

entries.zh: 断层是岩石中可发生相对滑移的面，不是空隙。
entries.en: A fault is a surface where rock can slip relatively, not an empty gap.

entries.zh: 标记线记录岩石先形变、后留下永久错位。
entries.en: The marker records deformation followed by a lasting offset.

entries.zh: 震中：震源正上方的地表点
entries.en: Epicenter: the surface point above the focus

entries.zh: 黄点代表一小块岩石，不是随波奔跑的球。
entries.en: A yellow point stands for a small piece of rock, not a ball travelling with the wave.
The fault dips down to the right
The marker records bending then offset

entries.zh: 沿同一倾斜断层比较两个起裂位置。
entries.en: Compare two rupture starts on the same dipping fault.
The flag farther from the focus

entries.zh: 传播较快的 P 波
走滑断层 · 水平错开
新版讲解待配音；可先读文字并观察模型，旧录音不会配新句。
entries.en: New narration is pending. Read and explore; old clips will not play over changed text.

entries.zh: 地球坚硬的外层由缓慢运动的板块组成，并不是松散漂浮的碎石。持续构造作用让岩石受力。接下来只观察其中一小段断层，不是把整块板块用手推动。
entries.en: Earth’s rigid outer layer forms slowly moving plates, not loose floating stones. Tectonic loading stresses rock. Here we inspect a small fault segment, not push an entire plate by hand.

entries.zh: 断层两侧接触面的摩擦能让局部暂时卡住，远处却仍在受力。坚硬岩石也能产生很小的弹性形变，把能量储存在形变中。标记线和能量条把这件事放大给你看；真实积累可能很慢，不能据此倒数地震。
entries.en: Friction can lock a local fault patch while loading continues farther away. Even hard rock deforms slightly and stores elastic energy. The marker and energy bar exaggerate this evidence; real loading can be slow and cannot provide an earthquake countdown.

entries.zh: 本模型的驱动力越过静摩擦门槛后，断层开始滑移。附近岩石部分回弹，弹性储能减少，一部分能量以地震波传播。两块岩石已有相对错位，所以回弹不是把断层两侧退回最初位置。
entries.en: When this model crosses its static-friction threshold, the fault slips. Nearby rock partly rebounds, reducing stored elastic energy; some energy travels as seismic waves. The blocks remain offset, so rebound does not restore their original positions.

entries.zh: “没有继续摇”与“没有发生过滑动”不同。对比最初和现在的标记线：弯曲减小了，跨断层的错位仍在。真实地震还可能有余震；这个单次事件模型不计算它们。
entries.en: No more shaking does not mean no slip occurred. Compare the marker before and after: bending decreases but offset remains. Real earthquakes may have aftershocks; this single-event model does not calculate them.

entries.zh: 远端向外拉伸时，上盘相对下盘沿倾斜断层向下滑。青箭头是远端受力方向，橙箭头是相对滑动；它们不是同一件事。这里固定几何与错位大小，只比较方向。
entries.en: Under extension, the hanging wall slips down relative to the footwall along the dipping fault. Cyan arrows show remote loading; orange arrows show relative slip. With geometry and offset fixed here, compare directions only.

entries.zh: 远端挤压时，上盘相对下盘沿倾斜断层向上滑。上盘指断层面上方的岩体，并不保证它始终比另一侧高。颜色相同的岩层帮助你确认相对错位。
entries.en: Under compression, the hanging wall slips up relative to the footwall along the dipping fault. Hanging wall means the block above the fault plane, not always the higher block. Matching rock layers reveal the relative offset.

entries.zh: 两侧沿断层走向水平错开。用俯视看前后相反方向的箭头，再用同一条标记确认错位。真实断层可以混合水平与上下运动，这里分开展示三种理想方向。
entries.en: The sides slip horizontally along the fault’s strike. Use the top view to compare opposite arrows and the same marker. Real faults can combine horizontal and vertical motion; these are separate idealized directions.

entries.zh: 震源是破裂最先开始的位置，震中是它的竖直地表投影。换起点会改变投影以及到各观测点的路程。破裂之后可以沿断层扩展，不是只有一个点在活动；这里没有求解有限破裂过程。
entries.en: The focus is where rupture starts; the epicenter is its vertical surface projection. Changing the start changes the projection and paths to observation points. Rupture can spread along a fault, but this model does not solve finite rupture propagation.

entries.zh: P 波传来时，邻近岩石沿传播方向交替压缩、伸展，恢复力把扰动继续传给下一处。跟着黄点看：它先向一边、再向另一边，最后回到原位；波前仍在向外走。
entries.en: In a P wave, nearby rock alternately compresses and stretches along the propagation direction. Restoring forces pass the disturbance onward. The yellow point moves one way, then back, returning to its origin while the front travels outward.

entries.zh: S 波让邻近岩石沿垂直于传播方向的方向往复剪切。它传播较慢，但不是因为要等 P 波结束才出发。对照同一个观测点的到时：路程相同，速度不同，所以先后到达。
entries.en: An S wave produces back-and-forth shear perpendicular to its propagation direction. It is slower, not waiting for P to finish before starting. At the same observation point, equal path lengths and different speeds give different arrival times.

entries.zh: 颜色表示两种波前；地下黄点和地表黄点表示岩石的局部运动，不是移动的能量球。先单看 P 或 S 的运动方向，再一起看它们的到时差。只有波经过的地方才在这次脉冲中振动。
entries.en: Colors show two wavefronts. Underground and surface yellow points represent local rock motion, not travelling energy balls. Inspect P or S motion first, then compare arrival times. A point moves during this pulse only as a wave passes it.

entries.zh: 单一弹簧式锁定—滑移示意；形变、错位与时间无真实尺度，不求解三维应力或摩擦发热。
entries.en: A single spring-like locked-slip illustration with exaggerated shape, offset and time; no 3D stress or frictional-heating solution.

entries.zh: 两个起点都在同一倾斜断层上；只比较起点与投影，不模拟破裂扩展。震中不等于最强振动点。
entries.en: Both starts lie on the same dipping fault. Compare starts and projections, not rupture propagation. Epicenter does not mean strongest shaking.

entries.zh: 均匀固体内的独立脉冲；P/S 同时开始，波速为示意单位。缺少表面波、折射、散射与真实地表强度；两观测点不能唯一定位。
entries.en: Independent pulses in a uniform solid. P/S start together in illustrative speed units; no surface waves, refraction, scattering or real ground intensity. Two points cannot uniquely locate an earthquake.

entries.zh: 起点改变了：投影与波路程已更新，旧到达记录已清除。
entries.en: Start changed: projection and paths updated; old arrivals cleared.

entries.zh: 这张独立比较图已换受力条件；前面的储能观察仍保留。
entries.en: This separate comparison changes loading; the earlier energy observation is preserved.
